mapper.insert: insert into wm_sn (sn_code, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure, batch_code, gen_date, workorder_id, status, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{snCode}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{unitOfMeasure}, #{batchCode}, now(), #{workorderId}, ifnull(#{status}, 'IN_STOCK'), '0', #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())

update wm_sn set del_flag = '1', update_time = now() where sn_id = #{snId} and status = 'IN_STOCK'
